_why: Dual down-stop honesty: margin from lug TOP to the window's far (head-side) edge when the flange rests on the hub. Negative margin means the lug meets the window edge BEFORE the flange lands - a solid alternative stop that just grows the float by |margin| (float stays under tol_axial's 1.2 ceiling for margin >= -0.55, so the floor here is -0.4). The twist stays available at either stop since the lug remains inside the pocket band by construction (contact = containment).
